scenarios.name: spot_mac01_hash
scenarios.subject: Toad Town mac_01, Mario placed at pos 0 0 200 (warp entry 0), cold det start with the fhash switch: the GX lists of frames 200 to 205 are hashed at the frame end (fhash lines).
scenarios.proves: FRAMEHASH3: the fhash line of a frame is a function of the build (det), so a base and a head build give equal fhash.txt when no draw changes.
scenarios.debug: warp=mac_01:0 pos=0:0:200 prof=4 fhash fhwin=200:6 loglevel=debug det
scenarios.reason: FRAMEHASH3: spot_mac01_det with fhash fhwin=200:6 in place of the shots. Cold start (as spot_mac01_det), cap 35 s, deadline 30 s. The fhash f205 line is the until.
